labels.label: Opponent Distance <=
labels.name: OpponentDistanceLE
labels.meaning: True when the distance to the opponent (P+0xedc[O.slot2], float) is <= the param (as float). False with no opponent.

labels.label: Opponent Distance <=
labels.name: OpponentDistanceLE
labels.meaning: True when the distance to the opponent (P+0xedc[O.slot2], float) is <= the param (as float). False with no opponent.

labels.label: Opponent Distance >=
labels.name: OpponentDistanceGE
labels.meaning: True when the distance to the opponent (P+0xedc[O.slot2]) is >= the param as float. False with no opponent.

labels.label: On Hit Not Blocked
labels.name: OnHitNotBlocked
labels.meaning: True when P's contact flags have 0x100 (P's attack connected) and the opponent's contact flags have bit 0x1 set and bit 0x4 clear (hit, not blocked).

labels.label: On Hit
labels.name: OnHit
labels.meaning: True when the player's contact flags P+0xfdc have bit 0x100 (my attack connected) and the opponent's contact flags O+0xfdc have bit 0 set, bit 2 clear and bit 3 (blocked) clear. False with no opponent.

labels.label: Opponent Flag FE4Positive And No Bit4
labels.name: OpponentFlagFE4PositiveAndNoBit4
labels.meaning: True when the opponent exists, the signed byte O+0xfe4 > 0, and bit 0x4 of O.contact_flags is clear.

labels.label: Opp Contact Flag0x100Hit No Bit3
labels.name: OppContactFlag0x100HitNoBit3
labels.meaning: Requires an opponent. True when P contact_flags has bit 0x100, the opponent's contact_flags low bits (&5) equal 1, bit 3 of the opponent's contact_flags is clear and the low 16 bits of the param are non-zero. Otherwise false.

labels.label: On Block
labels.name: OnBlock
labels.meaning: True when the opponent's contact flags O+0xfdc have bit 3 (blocked) and neither bit 2 nor bit 13 (0x2004). False with no opponent.

labels.label: On Whiff
labels.name: OnWhiff
labels.meaning: True when bit 9 (0x200) of P.contact_flags is set: the current attack whiffed.

labels.label: Attack Connected Flag
labels.name: AttackConnectedFlag
labels.meaning: Returns the byte P+0x694 (nonzero when P's attack connected, hit or block).

labels.label: On Hit
labels.name: OnHit
labels.meaning: True when bit 6 (0x40) of P+0x714 is set: the current attack hit.

labels.label: Field68DSet
labels.name: Field68DSet
labels.meaning: Returns the player byte at P+0x68d.

labels.label: Opp Contact Flag Bit31
labels.name: OppContactFlagBit31
labels.meaning: True when the opponent exists and bit 31 of its contact_flags is set.

labels.label: Opponent Contact Flag Bit9
labels.name: OpponentContactFlagBit9
labels.meaning: True when the opponent exists and bit 9 of its contact flags (O+0xfdc) is set.

labels.label: Throw Break Check4
labels.name: ThrowBreakCheck4
labels.meaning: Calls the shared throw-break helper FUN_14187b530(P, O, id, 4): it stores 4 (encrypted) at P+0x6b0 and tests the break-input mask at P+0x1028/0x102c against bit (1<<4)/(1<<8), plus other conditions. Result = helper's return.
labels.evidence: uVar35 = 4; bVar8 = FUN_14187b530(P,O,uVar3,uVar35); helper: mov [rcx+0x6b0],r9d ... test r9b,8 / shl edx,cl ...

labels.label: Throw Break Input Matches
labels.name: ThrowBreakInputMatches
labels.meaning: Calls FUN_14187b530(P, O, id, param): stores the param encrypted at P+0x6b0, then checks the break input: with P+0x102c == -1 nothing matches; if P+0x1028 & 8 only param 3 matches; else bit (1 << param) is tested against P+0x1028 / P+0x102c. Also true via FUN_1419137d0/FUN_141913c90; forced false when P+0x710 bit 0x1000 is set or when O+0x1c88 (counter-hit throw byte) is set and P+0x15b4 bit 1. Writes the result into P+0x710 bit 0x800 and, on success, calls FUN_141914250 and sets P+0x700 = 1.
labels.evidence: mov [rcx+0x6b0],r9d; Encrypt; ... shl edx,cl (1<<param); test edx,[P+0x1028]/[P+0x102c]; ... P+0x710 bit 0x800 = result

labels.meaning: Fails without opponent, on the 0x40 gate, or when O+0x704 bit 0x20 is set unless the id is the airborne variant and O+0x6CC == 1. Needs O angle <= 0x2AA9 and a high (0x512/0x806) or mid (0x217/0x31F/0x707) hit level. Finally FUN_14187b6c0(move+0x160, O+0x9C0, param) filters on the attack's hitbox/limb type: param 0 or 0x7D = any; 0x50 matches a hitbox of type 0x50.

labels.label: Parry Group OFront
labels.name: ParryGroupOFront
labels.meaning: Fails without opponent or on the 0x40 gate. Needs O angle < 0x2AAA, then true when the opponent's current move id (move+0xF0 decrypted) is in move-group list low16(param) of P's moveset (P+0x3B58 +0x270, 0-terminated) (func 0x14187ACE0).
labels.evidence: func_0x14187ace0(P, FUN_14180dab0(O+0x3e0 + 0xf0), uVar2): r10 = [[P+0x3b58]+0x270]; scan from index until 0

labels.label: Parry Group OFront
labels.name: ParryGroupOFront

labels.evidence: func_0x14187ace0(P, FUN_14180dab0(O+0x3e0 + 0xf0), uVar2): r10 = [[P+0x3b58]+0x270]; scan from index until 0

Needs P's angle < 0x2AAA, then a low hit level (0x10F/0x41F) on O+0x510. Finally FUN_14187b6c0(move+0x160, O+0x9C0, param) filters on the attack's hitbox/limb type: param 0 or 0x7D = any; 0x50 matches a hitbox of type 0x50.
labels.evidence: P angle SBORROW test then goto LAB_14188334b (low codes)

labels.label: Parry High Mid PFront
labels.name: ParryHighMidPFront
labels.meaning: Fails without opponent, on the 0x40 gate, or when O+0x704 bit 0x20 is set unless the id is 0x445 and O+0x6CC == 1. Needs P angle <= 0x2AA9 and a high or mid hit level (0x512/0x806/0x217/0x31F/0x707). Finally FUN_14187b6c0(move+0x160, O+0x9C0, param) filters on the attack's hitbox/limb type: param 0 or 0x7D = any; 0x50 matches a hitbox of type 0x50.

labels.label: Ground Ripple
labels.name: GroundRipple
labels.meaning: Spawns effect 0x72 at the player transform (P+0x2F0) and position (P+0x37D0) via TK__Effect_Spawn_maybe, then a second spawn through FUN_1418b4400 (tag 0x20252D6, slot P+0x160).

labels.label: Break Stage Tile
labels.name: BreakStageTile
labels.meaning: Floor or stage break effect at the player's position (P+0x2F0 transform, P+0x37D0 pos): param 0/1/2 selects strength 60/40/20 (with a level arg 0/1/2) passed to FUN_1419157c0; the 4th arg is true for 0x8027 (second break variant). If vulnerability bit 2 (P+0x434 & 4) is set, sub_141640920(P,5,result) follows.

labels.label: Spawn Ground Ripple Medium
labels.name: SpawnGroundRippleMedium
labels.meaning: On the first pass, spawns effect 0x73 at the player's x/z (P+0x2F0/P+0x2F8) with the y from sub_141611C50(P) (floor height), scale 1.0, via the shared effect-spawn tail.
labels.evidence: uStack_11b8 = P+0x2f0; uStack_11b4 = sub_141611C50(P); uStack_11b0 = P+0x2f8; uVar43 = 0x73; goto code_r0x000141899f1e

labels.label: Heavy Ground Ripple
labels.name: HeavyGroundRipple
labels.meaning: First pass: builds a position from P+0x2F0 (x), sub_141611C50(P) (floor height) and P+0x2F8 (z), w = 1, then spawns effect 0x74 at the P+0x37D0 context. The param (0) is unused.

labels.label: Fire Burn Effect Self
labels.name: FireBurnEffectSelf
labels.meaning: First pass: spawns attached effect 0x87 (0xB5 when param == 2) on up to 5 bones from the table at 0x1475BCF10. With param == 5 it starts at the third bone (3 bones) and uses variant 0. The spawns go through FUN_1418db460 with the player id.
labels.evidence: sub_1415B6140 = 0x1418AD920: edi=0x87; if (param==2) edi=0xb5; if (param==5) {start=2; param=0}; loop 5-start: hash=table[i]; GetSkeleton; FUN_141935c00; FUN_1418db460(Round3, edi, &P->id, &hash, ...)

labels.label: Opponent Effect By Low16
labels.name: OpponentEffectByLow16
labels.meaning: First pass only: if an opponent exists, calls sub_1415B6140(O, low16). The label says fire-burn VFX on the opponent; the code only shows a per-opponent call keyed by low16 (the burn effect variant, 0 in most uses).

labels.label: Play Vfx At Bone Toward Opponent
labels.name: PlayVfxAtBoneTowardOpponent
labels.meaning: Plays effect hi16 (mapped through FUN_1418b34e0) attached at bone lo16 of P. The direction is the horizontal vector from P (P+0x2F0/0x2F8) to the opponent (O+0x2F0/0x2F8, zero if no opponent), with Y from P+0x37D4.
labels.evidence: FUN_14195b770(lo16, &bonehash); sub_1415C4830(P, buf, &bonehash); dir = (O.x-P.x, P+0x37d4, O.z-P.z); FUN_141894730(hi16, P, &bonehash, buf, ...). FUN_141894730 (0x141894730): id = FUN_1418b34e0(arg1); FUN_1418db460 (attached spawn) / TK__Effect_Spawn_maybe(id ...)

labels.label: Play Common Vfx At Bone Self
labels.name: PlayCommonVfxAtBoneSelf
labels.meaning: Effect pass: converts the sign-extended low16 (bone index) to a bone hash, gets that bone's attach position on the player (sub_1415C4830) and plays common effect kind = param>>16 on the player there, with the player's effect position P+0x37D0.

labels.label: Self Effect By Param
labels.name: SelfEffectByParam
labels.meaning: Effect pass: converts the raw param into an effect handle with FUN_14195b770 and calls sub_1415B6260(P, &handle), i.e. applies it to the player itself (label: electric VFX on self).

labels.label: Electric Vfx Opponent [no effect in retail]
labels.name: ElectricVfxOpponent
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, passes FUN_14195b770(raw param) to sub_1415B6260(O, &h). That callee does nothing when the hash is 0; otherwise it spawns effect 0x88 on 5 fixed bones of the opponent's skeleton (bone table 0x1475BCF28). Opponent twin of 0x8019.

labels.label: Heat Smash Vfx Self
labels.name: HeatSmashVfxSelf
labels.meaning: First-pass switch. With param 0 and an active effect (P+0x1C32), it stops it (FUN_1418c9c90(dispatcher, 0x8C, slot, 1)), calls FUN_1418d9600, and sets 1C32/1C33=0 and 1C34=1. With a non-zero param, it gets the bone with hash 0x20252D6 from the skeleton and spawns a VFX there.

labels.label: Mouth Fog Vfx
labels.name: MouthFogVfx
labels.meaning: First pass: when P is UE-bound, P+0x16C != 10, P+8 is set and the stage check FUN_141299770 returns 0 or 1, spawns attached effect 0x78 at bone hash 0xB0781FA1. When P+0x16C == 0x2B and P+0x3B88 exists, it spawns a second 0x78 at bone 0x2EA6E625.
labels.evidence: FUN_141915a20: cmp [P+0x164],1; cmp [P+0x16c],0xa; FUN_141299770(); edx=0x78, bone 0xb0781fa1 -> FUN_1418db460; if ([P+0x16c]==0x2b && [P+0x3b88]) 2nd spawn bone 0x2ea6e625

labels.label: Spawn Bone Linked Effect67to69
labels.name: SpawnBoneLinkedEffect67to69
labels.meaning: First pass: param 0x67 / 0x68 / 0x69 selects a fixed bone hash (0x150F2E07 / 0xA7EE06D9 / 0x4A6809C5). The case reads that bone's transform from the skeleton (GetSkeleton + FUN_141935c00) and calls sub_1415A50D0(P, param, P, &hash) with the bone matrix. The param itself is the effect id passed on.
labels.evidence: if (param==0x67) {hash=0x150f2e07;...; sub_1415A50D0(P,0x67,P,&hash)} else if (0x68) {0xa7ee06d9 ...} else if (0x69) {hash=0x4a6809c5; sub_1415A50D0(P,0x69,P,&hash)}

labels.label: Play Common Vfx At Bone Self B
labels.name: PlayCommonVfxAtBoneSelfB
labels.meaning: Same as 0x8018 (different stack slots): bone hash from sign-extended low16, attach position on the player, common effect kind = param>>16 played on the player.

labels.label: Play Common Vfx At Bone Opponent
labels.name: PlayCommonVfxAtBoneOpponent
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists: bone hash from sign-extended low16, attach position on the opponent, and common effect kind = param>>16 played on the opponent with a fixed (0,1,0,0) vector.

labels.label: Break Stage Tile
labels.name: BreakStageTile
labels.meaning: Floor or stage break effect at the player's position (P+0x2F0 transform, P+0x37D0 pos): param 0/1/2 selects strength 60/40/20 (with a level arg 0/1/2) passed to FUN_1419157c0; the 4th arg is true for 0x8027 (second break variant). If vulnerability bit 2 (P+0x434 & 4) is set, sub_141640920(P,5,result) follows.

labels.label: Spawn Effect At Bone
labels.name: SpawnEffectAtBone
labels.meaning: Effect family, stage 1 case: maps s16 low16 to a bone name hash (FUN_14195b770) and calls FUN_1418dfd00(Round3, P+0x1A30, high16, &slot2(P+0x160), &boneHash). FUN_1418dfd00 is a player-scoped presentation event (message type 0x13, or Round3+0x8 effect interface vtable +0xB8).

labels.label: Stop Bone Effect
labels.name: StopBoneEffect
labels.meaning: Converts the raw param (bone index) to a bone hash, sends a type-0x14 UE effect message for the player slot P+0x160 with that hash (FUN_1418df9c0), then clears every entry of the 4-entry tracked-effect table P+0x2590..0x25CF whose key equals the hash (key set to 0xDC56D17A, the next two dwords zeroed).

labels.label: Spawn Effect72At Player
labels.name: SpawnEffect72AtPlayer
labels.meaning: Spawns effect 0x72 (the ground-ripple effect) at the player transform P+0x2F0 and position P+0x37D0 through a shared spawn tail.

labels.label: Spawn Facing Effects70 71
labels.name: SpawnFacingEffects70_71
labels.meaning: First pass: builds a transform at the player position (P+0x2F0/P+0x2F8, w = 1) rotated by the facing angle P+0x374, then spawns effect 0x71 and effect 0x70 with it through TK__Effect_Spawn_maybe.

labels.label: Char Hit Spark Self
labels.name: CharHitSparkSelf
labels.meaning: Resolves an effect from low16 (FUN_14195b770), spawns it on the player through sub_1415A4E80(P,0,P,effect) with facing P+0x376, then calls FUN_1418da960(mgr, side P+0x3AC4, 0xF).

labels.label: Char Hit Spark Self
labels.name: CharHitSparkSelf
labels.meaning: Resolves an effect from low16 (FUN_14195b770), spawns it on the player through sub_1415A4E80(P,0,P,effect) with facing P+0x376, then calls FUN_1418da960(mgr, side P+0x3AC4, 0xF).

labels.label: Compute Self Bone Pos Only [no effect in retail]
labels.name: ComputeSelfBonePosOnly
labels.meaning: Only the shared effect stage runs: it writes the position of the player's bone (sign-extended low16, sub_1415C47D0) into the global effect context (DAT_14959a218 +0x10). The later effect switch has no case for 0x8033, so nothing is spawned.
labels.evidence: case 0x8033: case 0x8037: puVar44 = auStack_9b8; lVar39 = P; uVar18 = local_1908; ... sub_1415C47D0(lVar39,puVar44,uVar18)

labels.label: Set Effect Direction From Param Bytes
labels.name: SetEffectDirectionFromParamBytes
labels.meaning: Builds a vector from param bytes (x = byte3, y = byte2, z = byte1, as floats), normalises it, combines it with the facing rotation (FUN_141813530 on P+0x17E, sin/cos) and stores the resulting orientation in P+0x420..0x42C. A zero vector clears P+0x420..0x42F. Continues to the shared effect code.
labels.evidence: fVar61=(float)(local_1900&0xff); fVar60=(float)(uVar21>>0x10&0xff); x=(float)(uVar21>>0x18); if (len2<=0) {P+0x420=0;P+0x428=0;} else {... sqrtps/divps ... *(float*)(P+0x420)=...}

labels.label: Play Common Vfx At Bone Self Staged
labels.name: PlayCommonVfxAtBoneSelfStaged
labels.meaning: Stage 1 writes the player's bone position (bone = sign-extended low16) into the global effect context; stage 2 converts the same low16 to a bone hash and plays common effect kind = param>>16 on the player at that position (FUN_141894730).
labels.evidence: stage1: lVar39=P; uVar18=local_1908; stage2: FUN_14195b770(local_1908,&h); FUN_141894730(uVar18 /*=local_1904*/,P,&h,local_18d8)

labels.label: Play Common Vfx At Bone Opponent Staged
labels.name: PlayCommonVfxAtBoneOpponentStaged
labels.meaning: Opponent version of 0x8037: if an opponent exists, its bone position (low16) is written to the effect context and common effect kind = param>>16 is played on the opponent at that bone.

labels.label: Play Character Vfx
labels.name: PlayCharacterVfx
labels.meaning: Shared VFX body. The effect is resolved from param>>8 via FUN_14195b770. For 0x8049, FUN_141894730(param & 0xFF, P) is called (common effect by low byte). For 0x8039, FUN_1418987d0(P, param & 0xFF, effect, pos) spawns a character trail effect with the facing P+0x376.

labels.label: Spawn Linked Effect On Opponent Bone
labels.name: SpawnLinkedEffectOnOpponentBone
labels.meaning: First-pass effect tail, opponent required. The 0x1547 switch puts the opponent's bone (param >> 8) position in pfVar48 (lVar39 = opponent). The case maps param >> 8 to a bone hash. 0x803B calls FUN_141898740(P, effect = low byte, O, ...) with facing P+0x376. 0x805E calls sub_1415A50D0(P, low byte, O, hash) with the effect aim vector (scratch +0x20) as direction. Results go to P+0x1560/P+0x1570.
labels.evidence: 1547: case 0x803b/0x805e: if (O) { puVar44=..; uVar18=param>>8; lVar39 stays O } -> sub_1415C47D0(O,buf,param>>8); 1706: FUN_14195b770(param>>8,&hash); 0x803b: FUN_141898740(P,(u8)param,O); else sub_1415A50D0(P,(u8)param,O,&hash)

labels.label: Spawn Linked Effect From Own Bone
labels.name: SpawnLinkedEffectFromOwnBone
labels.meaning: First-pass effect tail: the 0x1547 switch puts the position of P's bone (param >> 8) in pfVar48. The case maps param >> 8 to a bone hash, picks the target (P+0x3708 when that player is UE-bound, else the opponent), and calls FUN_141898740(target, effect = low byte, P, hash). The facing P+0x376 and outputs P+0x1560/P+0x1570 go on the stack. 0x804A shares the tail but calls FUN_141894730 (plain effect at bone, oriented by P+0x37D0) instead.
labels.evidence: 1547: case 0x803d: lVar39=P; uVar18=param>>8 -> sub_1415C47D0(P,buf,byte1); 1706: FUN_14195b770(byte1,&hash); tgt = ue_bound(P+0x3708) ? P+0x3708 : P+0x3b78; FUN_141898740(tgt,(u8)param,P,&hash)

labels.label: Hit Spark At Bone
labels.name: HitSparkAtBone
labels.meaning: Spawns effect 100 (hit spark) at the world position of bone `param` of P, oriented by P+0x37D0. Because the id is 100, FUN_1418b2400 also records the spark position and direction in Round4 +0x3D0/+0x3E0 (last hit-spark position). 0x803F shares the body.
labels.evidence: case 0x803e/0x803f: FUN_1418b2400(100, pfVar48, P+0x37d0); FUN_1418b2400 (0x1418B2400): TK__Effect_Spawn_maybe(Round3, id, pos, dir); if (id == 0x64) { Round4+0x3d0 = *pos; Round4+0x3e0 = *dir; }

labels.label: Hit Spark On Opponent
labels.name: HitSparkOnOpponent
labels.meaning: Effect family: stage 1 requires an opponent; stage 2 calls FUN_1418b2400(100, effect position, P+0x37D0), i.e. effect 100 at the computed position.

labels.label: Spawn Hit Spark At Bone
labels.name: SpawnHitSparkAtBone
labels.meaning: Second pass: converts the param (bone index) into a bone hash, calls sub_1415A4E80(P, 0, P, &hash, ...) with the facing (P+0x376) to spawn a hit spark, runs FUN_1418da960(Round3, P[0x3AC4], 0xF) and FUN_1418b2400(100, pos, P+0x37D0), then falls into the shared heavy-sparks tail (code_r0x00014189a352).

labels.label: Heavy Hit Sparks
labels.name: HeavyHitSparks
labels.meaning: Effect pass (needs an opponent): converts low16 to an effect handle, plays it through sub_1415A4E80(P, 0, P, &handle) with an identity transform, then FUN_1418da960(mgr, slot P+0x3AC4, 0xF) and FUN_1418b2400(100, pos, P+0x37D0).

labels.label: Spawn Effect6EAt Self Bone
labels.name: SpawnEffect6EAtSelfBone
labels.meaning: Stage 1 (default case) writes the position of the player's bone #param into the effect context; stage 2 spawns fixed effect 0x6E there with the player position P+0x37D0 (TK__Effect_Spawn_maybe).

labels.label: Spawn Effect6F
labels.name: SpawnEffect6F
labels.meaning: Spawns effect 0x6F at attach point pfVar48 and the player position P+0x37D0.

labels.label: Play Stage Vfx At Bone
labels.name: PlayStageVfxAtBone
labels.meaning: Spawns a stage effect at bone `param` of P plus the offset P+0x410..0x41C (set by 0x807B). It is oriented by P+0x420..0x42C (set by 0x8034) when that vector is non-zero, else by P+0x37D0. P+0x430 (set by 0x807B) makes the spawner snap Y to the highest player floor height. The effect identity comes from P+0x1A30, not from the param.
labels.evidence: 1547-switch default: sub_1415C47D0(P, buf, param) -> pfVar48; case 0x8046: pos = P+0x410.. + pfVar48; FUN_1418b4400(&pos, |P+0x420|>0 ? P+0x420 : P+0x37d0, *(P+0x1a30), 0, flag=P+0x430, &slot, tag 0x20252d6). FUN_1418b4400 (0x1418B4400): if flag, Y = max over active players of sub_141611C50 (floor height); then Round3 FUN_1418dd2f0(pos, rot, P+0x1a30, ...).

labels.label: Spawn Effect6B
labels.name: SpawnEffect6B
labels.meaning: Second pass: TK__Effect_Spawn_maybe(Round3, 0x6B, pfVar48, P+0x37D0) spawns effect 0x6B at the current effect position. The param is not read here.

labels.label: Play Character Vfx
labels.name: PlayCharacterVfx
labels.meaning: Shared VFX body. The effect is resolved from param>>8 via FUN_14195b770. For 0x8049, FUN_141894730(param & 0xFF, P) is called (common effect by low byte). For 0x8039, FUN_1418987d0(P, param & 0xFF, effect, pos) spawns a character trail effect with the facing P+0x376.

labels.label: Play Common Vfx
labels.name: PlayCommonVfx
labels.meaning: Effect pass (needs an opponent): converts byte1 of the param into an effect handle and plays it through FUN_141894730(b0, actor, &handle, pos, ...), where the actor is the linked actor at P+0x3708 when it is bound (+0x164 == 1), else the opponent. b0 is the variant/attach selector.

labels.label: Tile Break Vfx Self
labels.name: TileBreakVfxSelf
labels.meaning: Spawns a VFX on the player itself. The line-1547 switch sets target = P and effect index = param>>8. The second switch picks a slot byte (P+0x3AC4 in some round modes, else 0xFD) and calls FUN_1418da960(dispatcher, slot, 0x228). It then spawns at P+0x37D0 with FUN_1419157c0. The low byte of the param picks the variant (0 -> 0x3C, 1 -> 0x28, ...); id 0x8050 passes true as the last argument.

labels.label: Item State Event
labels.name: ItemStateEvent
labels.meaning: First-pass effect tail (no bone lookup). When P is UE-bound and the UE bridge is ready (FUN_140f12fd0), it sends presentation message 0x26 (player id P+4, param >> 8, param low byte), or calls Round3 iface +0x190 directly.

labels.label: Spawn Effect At Bone Packed
labels.name: SpawnEffectAtBonePacked
labels.meaning: Effect family stage 2: when P is UE-bound (P+0x164 == 1), maps byte1 to a bone hash and calls FUN_1418b42e0(&P+4, byte3, byte2, &P+4, &boneHash). The callee looks the bone up on that player's skeleton (TK__Player::GetSkeleton + 0x141935c00) and, if found, calls the effect presentation event 0x1418DC510 (message type 0x28) with the bone matrix.

labels.label: Spawn Effect77
labels.name: SpawnEffect77
labels.meaning: Effect pass: spawns fixed effect id 0x77 at the hit position with the orientation vector copied from P+0x3710.

labels.label: Tile Break Vfx Self
labels.name: TileBreakVfxSelf
labels.meaning: Spawns a VFX on the player itself. The line-1547 switch sets target = P and effect index = param>>8. The second switch picks a slot byte (P+0x3AC4 in some round modes, else 0xFD) and calls FUN_1418da960(dispatcher, slot, 0x228). It then spawns at P+0x37D0 with FUN_1419157c0. The low byte of the param picks the variant (0 -> 0x3C, 1 -> 0x28, ...); id 0x8050 passes true as the last argument.

labels.label: Play Environment Vfx
labels.name: PlayEnvironmentVfx
labels.meaning: Resolves an effect from param byte 2 (FUN_14195b770) and spawns it with param byte 3 as kind (FUN_1418dcfb0, slot P+0x160). If byte 1 is non-zero, it is recorded in the per-player tracked-effect table at P+0x2590 (16-byte entries, sentinel 0xDC56D17A = empty): an existing handle with the same id is refreshed (FUN_1418df9c0) and the entry is overwritten.

labels.label: Set Effect Attach Bone
labels.name: SetEffectAttachBone
labels.meaning: Second pass only. Copies bit 0 of high16 into bit 11 of P+0x714. Converts signed low16 (a bone index) into a bone hash (FUN_14195b770) and stores it in P+0x400. Looks up that bone's transform and writes it, scaled by 100, into the current effect spawn context (lVar28+0x20..0x2C). This picks the bone that effects spawned next attach to.

labels.label: Spawn Vfx At Offset
labels.name: SpawnVfxAtOffset
labels.meaning: Spawns an effect (rec[1]) at an attach point (rec[2], via sub_1415C47D0) offset by rec[3]*40 forward and rec[4]*20 sideways, rotated by the player's yaw. 0x8055 sets a variant flag (bVar58).

labels.label: Spawn Vfx At Offset
labels.name: SpawnVfxAtOffset
labels.meaning: Spawns an effect (rec[1]) at an attach point (rec[2], via sub_1415C47D0) offset by rec[3]*40 forward and rec[4]*20 sideways, rotated by the player's yaw. 0x8055 sets a variant flag (bVar58).

labels.label: Spawn Vfx At Offset2
labels.name: SpawnVfxAtOffset2
labels.meaning: Like 0x8054: spawns effect rec[1] at attach point rec[2] (sub_1415C47D0), offset rec[3]*40 forward and rec[4]*20 sideways in the player's yaw frame.

labels.label: Set Flag155D
labels.name: SetFlag155D

labels.label: Set Effect Offset

labels.meaning: Second switch: writes the vec4 (float(rec[1]), float(rec[2]), float(rec[3]), 1.0) to P+0x1560..0x156C. Effect-spawn properties read it as their offset (0x805D/0x807D pass P+0x1560 / P+0x1570).

labels.label: Send Bone Effect Event20
labels.name: SendBoneEffectEvent20

labels.label: Spawn Effect On Self
labels.name: SpawnEffectOnSelf
labels.meaning: The line-1547 switch sets target = P and index = param>>8. The second switch resolves the effect id with FUN_14195b770(low16>>8) and spawns with the offsets P+0x1560/P+0x1570 (see 0x8058). 0x807D uses FUN_141894730(low byte, P, &id, ...); 0x805D uses sub_1415A50D0(P, low byte, P, &id, ...).

labels.name: SpawnLinkedEffectOnOpponentBone
labels.meaning: First-pass effect tail, opponent required. The 0x1547 switch puts the opponent's bone (param >> 8) position in pfVar48 (lVar39 = opponent). The case maps param >> 8 to a bone hash. 0x803B calls FUN_141898740(P, effect = low byte, O, ...) with facing P+0x376. 0x805E calls sub_1415A50D0(P, low byte, O, hash) with the effect aim vector (scratch +0x20) as direction. Results go to P+0x1560/P+0x1570.

labels.label: Set Effect Aim From Facing374

labels.meaning: Sets the effect aim vector in the scratch slot (DAT_14959a218 ->+8 +0x20) to 1000 units along the angle (param low16 + P+0x374), using sin/cos (FUN_1418eb330 / FUN_1418eb050) on the horizontal plane. 0x8073 copies that vector to P+0x3F0, and 0x8078/0x8079/0x807A/0x807C/0x8040 use it as the spawn direction.

labels.label: Set Effect Aim From Local Offset
labels.name: SetEffectAimFromLocalOffset
labels.meaning: Converts the local 2D offset (x = float(param hi16), z = float(param s16 lo16)) to a world point with FUN_14188d870(P, ...) and stores it as the effect aim vector (scratch DAT_14959a218 ->+8 +0x20). That is the vector 0x8073 copies to P+0x3F0 and the scratch-direction spawns use.

labels.label: Set Effect Aim From Facing376
labels.name: SetEffectAimFromFacing376
labels.meaning: Sets the effect aim vector (scratch +0x20) to 1000 units along the angle (param low16 + P+0x376) on the horizontal plane. Same as 0x8074 but relative to P+0x376.

labels.label: Set Effect Aim From Angles
labels.name: SetEffectAimFromAngles
labels.meaning: Sets the effect aim vector (scratch +0x20) to 1000 units along a direction built from two rotations: an angle from the param, then the facing P+0x376. labels.label: Set Both Hands Pose

labels.name: PlayWingAnim

labels.label: Throw Camera
labels.name: ThrowCamera
labels.meaning: Camera switch: needs ue_bound == 1 and an opponent. Each entry is a list of 12-byte variants {weight, id, ...}, and the function picks one at random by weight (FUN_1418be710) and starts that camera. 0x86A5 is the same call with mode 1.

labels.meaning: Second pass: if rec[3] != 0, writes rec[4] to P+0xD7C and rec[3] to P+0xD80, and sets P+0xD84 = 1 when the param == 15.

labels.label: Play System Cue
labels.name: PlaySystemCue
labels.meaning: Only in the second pass: a switch on the param picks a fixed cue id and calls FUN_1418cd760(Round3, id, &DAT_14959a14c): 0 -> 0xB, 1 -> 0x28D9, 2 -> 0x28A5, 3 -> 0x28A6, 4 -> 0x28B2, ... FUN_1418cd760 is a presentation event (message type 0x39 when queued) carrying the id and a 4-byte value.

labels.label: Store Current Move Key
labels.name: StoreCurrentMoveKey
labels.meaning: UE-bound only: computes a key from the current move (FUN_14180dab0(P+0x3E0); the value -0x3AEB45EE is replaced by 0xF976102A), registers it with the Round3 object for this player slot (FUN_1418dd9f0, FUN_1418df4f0), and when the round state (Round4 +0x28) is 0 or 1 also stores it in P+0x27E0.
labels.evidence: iVar19 = FUN_14180dab0(*(P + 0x3e0)); if (iVar19 == -0x3aeb45ee) key = 0xf976102a; ... if (state == 0 || state == 1) *(undefined4 *)(P + 0x27e0) = key;

labels.label: Play Voice Clip
labels.name: PlayVoiceClip
labels.meaning: Sound switch (rec[1..3] copied): when P is UE-bound, looks up voice entry (group = param hi16, index = lo16) with sub_1415A3600 (retail 0x14188D780). Skips the entry when it is missing or its hash at +0x10 is 0x88E3EE99 (none). Otherwise it plays it through Round3 (FUN_1418dd9f0 with the slot, FUN_1418df4f0 with P), and when Round4+0x28 is 0 or 1 it stores the hash in P+0x27E0.
labels.evidence: code_r0x00014189d6f9: if (P->ue_bound!=1) return; e=sub_1415A3600(P,hi16,lo16); if(!e || e->hash==-0x771c1167) return; FUN_1418dd9f0(Round3,&slot,&hash); FUN_1418df4f0(Round3,P,&hash); if (Round4+0x28 in {0,1}) P+0x27e0=hash

labels.label: Set Camera Zoom Preset
labels.name: SetCameraZoomPreset
labels.meaning: Sets the camera preset P+0x56C = low16 and its duration/weight P+0x570 = rec[2] (100 if 0). Ignored while P+0x4F4 != 0 and the current preset is 0x8FD (2301).

labels.label: Start Attached Vfx
labels.name: StartAttachedVfx
labels.meaning: Starts the persistent per-player effect FUN_1418b34e0(param) (table for 0..0x4F, else min(param, 200)): sends presentation message 7 (slot P+0x160, effect id) when the player is UE-bound, then message 6 (effect id). 0x8024 stops the same ids (message 9) and, for ids 125/189, also clears bit 0x800000 of P+0x710.
labels.evidence: uVar62 = FUN_1418b34e0(param); FUN_1418c9190(Round3, id, &slot) -> msg type 7 / iface +0x38; FUN_1418c9320(Round3, id) -> msg type 6 / iface +0x40. 0x8024: FUN_1418c9c90(id) -> msg 9 / iface +0x50; if ((id-0x7d) & ~0x40) == 0: P+0x710 &= ~0x800000

labels.label: Stop Vfx
labels.name: StopVfx
labels.meaning: Maps the param to an effect id (FUN_1418b34e0, table over 0..0x4F) and stops it for this player (FUN_1418c9c90, slot P+0x160). If the id is 0x7D or 0xBD, also clears bit 23 of P+0x710.

labels.label: Play Vfx Self
labels.name: PlayVfxSelf

labels.label: Camera Shake Custom Param

labels.name: SpawnEffectAtFxPosSelf

labels.label: Spawn Effect At Fx Pos Opponent
labels.name: SpawnEffectAtFxPosOpponent
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, same as 0x802D but using the opponent's stored effect position O+0x37E0 and O+0x37F0; the spawn is still issued for P.

labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, writes the low 16 bits of rec[2] to element [param-1] of the opponent's u16 array O+0x1822.

labels.label: Add Opponent U16Array1822
labels.name: AddOpponentU16Array1822
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, adds rec[2] to element (param-1) of the opponent's u16 array at O+0x1822. No bounds check.

labels.label: Sub Opponent U16Array1822
labels.name: SubOpponentU16Array1822
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, subtracts rec[2] from element (param-1) of the opponent's u16 array at O+0x1822.

labels.label: Add Opponent Total Damage Taken

labels.label: Sub Opponent Total Damage Taken
labels.name: SubOpponentTotalDamageTaken
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, subtracts the raw param from O+0x1608 (total damage taken).

labels.label: Set Value1688
labels.name: SetValue1688

labels.label: Set Opponent Subobj Int1 [no effect in retail]
labels.name: SetOpponentSubobjInt1

labels.label: Add Opponent Subobj Int1 [no effect in retail]
labels.name: AddOpponentSubobjInt1
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, adds the low 16 bits of the param to slot 1 of the int array at (O+0x3870)+0x604 (the callee does nothing if O+0x3870 is null).

labels.label: Sub Opponent Subobj Int1 [no effect in retail]
labels.name: SubOpponentSubobjInt1
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, subtracts the low 16 bits of the param from slot 1 of the int array at (O+0x3870)+0x604 (the callee does nothing if O+0x3870 is null).

labels.name: SetOpponentSubobjInt2

labels.label: Add Opponent Subobj Int2 [no effect in retail]
labels.name: AddOpponentSubobjInt2
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, adds the low 16 bits of the param to slot 2 of the int array at (O+0x3870)+0x604 (the callee does nothing if O+0x3870 is null).

labels.label: Sub Opponent Subobj Int2 [no effect in retail]
labels.name: SubOpponentSubobjInt2
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, subtracts the low 16 bits of the param from slot 2 of the int array at (O+0x3870)+0x604 (the callee does nothing if O+0x3870 is null).

labels.label: Set Opponent15E4
labels.name: SetOpponent15E4
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, writes low16 to O+0x15E4. Opponent-side twin of 0x80D7 (which writes P+0x15E4).

labels.label: Add Opponent15E4
labels.name: AddOpponent15E4

labels.label: Sub Opponent15E4
labels.name: SubOpponent15E4

labels.name: OrOpponent15E4
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, ORs low16 into O+0x15E4.

labels.label: And Opponent15E4
labels.name: AndOpponent15E4
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, ANDs O+0x15E4 with low16 (which also clears the upper 16 bits).

labels.label: Set Opponent Devil State
labels.name: SetOpponentDevilState
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists: when the opponent's permanent-devil flag O+0x15EC is 0, writes low16 to the opponent's devil state O+0x15E8; otherwise forces O+0x15E8 = 1.

labels.label: Add Opponent Devil State
labels.name: AddOpponentDevilState
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists: when the opponent's permanent-devil flag O+0x15EC is 0, adds low16 to the opponent's devil state O+0x15E8; otherwise forces O+0x15E8 = 1.

labels.label: Sub Opponent Devil State
labels.name: SubOpponentDevilState
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists: when the opponent's permanent-devil flag O+0x15EC is 0, subtracts low16 from the opponent's devil state O+0x15E8; otherwise forces O+0x15E8 = 1.

labels.label: Or Opponent Devil State
labels.name: OrOpponentDevilState
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists: when the opponent's permanent-devil flag O+0x15EC is 0, ORs low16 into the opponent's devil state O+0x15E8; otherwise forces O+0x15E8 = 1.

labels.label: And Opponent Devil State
labels.name: AndOpponentDevilState
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists: when the opponent's permanent-devil flag O+0x15EC is 0, ANDs low16 into the opponent's devil state O+0x15E8; otherwise forces O+0x15E8 = 1.

labels.label: Set Short Flag
labels.name: SetShortFlag

labels.name: AddToShortFlag
labels.meaning: If high16 < 100: short_flags[high16] (P+0x168C + 2*i) += signed low16.

labels.label: Sub From Short Flag
labels.name: SubFromShortFlag
labels.meaning: If high16 < 100: short_flags[high16] (P+0x168C + 2*i) -= signed low16.

labels.label: Set Opponent Short Flag
labels.name: SetOpponentShortFlag
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists and high16 < 100: opponent short_flags[high16] = low16.

labels.label: Add To Opponent Short Flag
labels.name: AddToOpponentShortFlag
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists and high16 < 100: opponent short_flags[high16] += signed low16.

labels.label: Sub From Opponent Short Flag
labels.name: SubFromOpponentShortFlag
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists and high16 < 100: opponent short_flags[high16] -= signed low16.

labels.label: Set Int Flag
labels.name: SetIntFlag
labels.meaning: Sets int flag number high16 (< 50) to the sign-extended low16: P+0x1754[high16] = (s16)low16.

labels.label: Add To Int Flag
labels.name: AddToIntFlag
labels.meaning: If high16 < 50: int_flags[high16] (P+0x1754 + 4*i) += signed low16.

labels.label: Sub From Int Flag
labels.name: SubFromIntFlag
labels.meaning: If high16 < 50: int_flags[high16] -= signed low16.

labels.label: Set Opponent Int Flag
labels.name: SetOpponentIntFlag
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists and high16 < 50: opponent int_flags[high16] = signed low16.

labels.label: Add To Opponent Int Flag
labels.name: AddToOpponentIntFlag
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists and high16 < 50: opponent int_flags[high16] += signed low16.

labels.label: Sub From Opponent Int Flag
labels.name: SubFromOpponentIntFlag
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists and high16 < 50: opponent int_flags[high16] -= signed low16.

labels.label: Sub Value1688
labels.name: SubValue1688

labels.name: SetValue5DC

labels.label: Add Value5DC
labels.name: AddValue5DC
labels.meaning: Adds low16 to P+0x5DC.

labels.label: Sub Value5DC
labels.name: SubValue5DC
labels.meaning: Subtracts low16 from P+0x5DC.

labels.label: Store Heat State
labels.name: StoreHeatState
labels.meaning: Writes rec[2] into slot (param - 1) of the u32[4] array at P+0x2520 (fatal if param is not 1..4).

labels.label: Add To Heat State
labels.name: AddToHeatState
labels.meaning: Adds rec[2] to heat-state slot (param-1) of the u32[4] array at P+0x2520; fatal index error if the param is not 1..4.

labels.label: Sub From Heat State
labels.name: SubFromHeatState
labels.meaning: Subtracts rec[2] from heat-state slot (param-1) at P+0x2520; fatal if the param is not 1..4.

labels.label: Store Opponent Heat State
labels.name: StoreOpponentHeatState
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, writes rec[2] into the opponent's heat-state slot (param-1) at O+0x2520 via the bounds-checked accessor.

labels.label: Add Heat State Opponent
labels.name: AddHeatStateOpponent
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, adds rec[2] to the opponent's heat-state int slot (param - 1) at +0x2520 (same array as the retail 'Heat State X == Y' requirement).

labels.label: Sub From Opponent Heat State
labels.name: SubFromOpponentHeatState
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, subtracts rec[2] from the opponent's heat-state slot (param-1) at O+0x2520.

labels.label: Queue Hp Cmd Mode11
labels.name: QueueHpCmdMode11
labels.meaning: Queues an HP-change command of mode 11 (P+0x103C = 0xB) with amount = low16, P+0x1048 = 1, P+0x1049 = 0.

labels.label: Inflict Recoverable Damage Self
labels.name: InflictRecoverableDamageSelf
labels.meaning: Queues a self-damage request: type 12 at P+0x103C, amount = param low16 at P+0x1040, P+0x1048 = 1 (recoverable), P+0x1049 = 0.

labels.label: Reset Timers1AF4All Players
labels.name: ResetTimers1AF4AllPlayers
labels.meaning: If P+0x1AF4 > 0, clears it and sets input_mode (P+0x2940) = 2. Clears P+0x1AF8 if > 0. For every active round player, sets player+0x1D88 = 0.

labels.label: Set Clone Flag27C4
labels.name: SetCloneFlag27C4
labels.meaning: Stores (param != 0) at P+0x27C4, right after the clone offset block written by 0x814A.

labels.label: Set Clone Offset
labels.name: SetCloneOffset
labels.meaning: Stores a full clone offset: P+0x27B0 = (rec[1], rec[2], rec[3], 1.0) as floats and P+0x27C0 = rec[4] degrees converted to radians, then calls sub_14161A510(P).

labels.label: Add Recoverable Health
labels.name: AddRecoverableHealth
labels.meaning: Queues a health operation of kind 0xD with amount = param: P+0x103C = 13, P+0x1040 = param, P+0x1048 = 1, P+0x1049 = 0.

labels.label: Set Flag951
labels.name: SetFlag951
labels.meaning: Stores (param != 0) at P+0x951.

labels.label: Set Heat Value2540
labels.name: SetHeatValue2540
labels.meaning: Stores param into the encrypted value at P+0x2540 (FUN_14188bcc0 = store + TK__EncryptValue/DecryptValue). The findings log shows +0x2540 = 300 during Heat.
labels.evidence: FUN_14188bcc0(P + 0x2540,uVar21);  callee: mov [rcx],edx; call TK__EncryptValue; jmp TK__DecryptValue

labels.label: Add Heat Gauge Clamped
labels.name: AddHeatGaugeClamped
labels.meaning: Adds the signed param to the encrypted gauge P+0x2540 (EncAdd), then clamps it at 0 when it drops below. Usual param -600 spends heat.

labels.label: Set Timer27CC
labels.name: SetTimer27CC
labels.meaning: Stores the raw param in P+0x27cc. Sheet calls it a freeze timer; the body is a plain store, its consumer is not visible here.

labels.label: Set Modifier103C Mode14
labels.name: SetModifier103C_Mode14
labels.meaning: Writes the modifier block like 0x8089 with mode 0xE: P+0x103C = 0xE, P+0x1040 = -low16, P+0x1048 = 1, P+0x1049 = 0.

labels.label: Set Devil Permanent
labels.name: SetDevilPermanent
labels.meaning: Stores low16 at P+0x15EC (permanent devil flag); if non-zero also sets devil state P+0x15E8 = 1.

labels.label: Set P20Flag
labels.name: SetP20Flag
labels.meaning: Sets P20 flag number param (1-based) to rec[2]: the 20-u32 array at P+0x584 through the bounds-checked accessor.

labels.label: Add To P20Flag
labels.name: AddToP20Flag
labels.meaning: Adds low16 to P20 flag (param-1) of the u32[20] array at P+0x584 (bounds-checked accessor).

labels.label: Sub From P20Flag
labels.name: SubFromP20Flag
labels.meaning: Subtracts low16 from P20 flag (param-1) at P+0x584.

labels.label: Set Story Script Flag
labels.name: SetStoryScriptFlag
labels.meaning: Writes the raw 32-bit param to P+0x1600 (story scripted flag).

labels.label: Add To Story Script Flag
labels.name: AddToStoryScriptFlag
labels.meaning: Adds the raw param to P+0x1600.

labels.label: Sub From Story Script Flag
labels.name: SubFromStoryScriptFlag
labels.meaning: Subtracts the raw param from P+0x1600.

labels.label: Set Flag Byte Array6E5
labels.name: SetFlagByteArray6E5
labels.meaning: Writes a bool into the byte array at P+0x6E5 indexed by the high 16 bits of the param: true when the low 16 bits are 0.

labels.label: Set Flag714Bit26
labels.name: SetFlag714Bit26
labels.meaning: Sets bit 26 (0x4000000) of P+0x714 to (param != 0).

labels.label: Store Pair In Array E60
labels.name: StorePairInArrayE60
labels.meaning: For index param < 10: element param of the array at P+0xE60 (TK__ArrayQ_At10) gets {rec[2], rec[3]} (two u32).

labels.label: Set Floor Blast Flag
labels.name: SetFloorBlastFlag
labels.meaning: Writes low16 to P+0x5D8 (floor blast flag).

labels.label: Add To Floor Blast Flag
labels.name: AddToFloorBlastFlag
labels.meaning: Adds low16 to P+0x5D8.

labels.label: Sub From Floor Blast Flag
labels.name: SubFromFloorBlastFlag
labels.meaning: Subtracts low16 from P+0x5D8.

labels.label: Set Allow Blocking
labels.name: SetAllowBlocking
labels.meaning: Writes the low 16 bits of the param to P+0x6C8.

labels.label: Set Ki Charge State
labels.name: SetKiChargeState
labels.meaning: Stores the low 16 bits of the param in P+0x15A4. That field is what requirements 157/158 ('If Player is (NOT) Ki Charged') read, so this gives the Ki-charge state (guaranteed counter hit). The param, usually 330, is most likely a duration in frames.

labels.label: Start Timed159C
labels.name: StartTimed159C
labels.meaning: If the timer P+0x15A0 has expired (< 1), stores the low16 param in P+0x159C and restarts the timer at 30 frames.

labels.label: Reset1598 1C1C
labels.name: Reset1598_1C1C
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x1598 = 0 and the u16 P+0x1C1C = 0.

labels.label: Set Field4F0
labels.name: SetField4F0
labels.meaning: Stores the low 16 bits of the param in P+0x4F0. Retail data always uses 255, the same 0xFF that the jump/reset properties 0x8296, 0x8297, 0x8391, 0x83C1 write there.

labels.label: Detach Position
labels.name: DetachPosition
labels.meaning: Sets bit 0 of P+0x704 to bit 0 of the param.

labels.label: Detach Position
labels.name: DetachPosition
labels.meaning: Sets bit 0 of P+0x704 to bit 0 of the param.

labels.label: Set Flag704 2
labels.name: SetFlag704_2
labels.meaning: Copies bit 0 of low16 into bit 1 (0x2) of P+0x704.

labels.label: Detach Height Smooth
labels.name: DetachHeightSmooth
labels.meaning: Sets bit 2 (0x4) of P+0x704 to bit 0 of the param.

labels.label: Set Flag704 8
labels.name: SetFlag704_8
labels.meaning: Sets or clears bit 0x8 of P+0x704 from bit 0 of the param (1 = set, 0 = clear).

labels.label: Set Flag704 10
labels.name: SetFlag704_10
labels.meaning: Copies bit 0 of the low 16 bits of the param into bit 4 (0x10) of P+0x704.

labels.label: Set Parry Immunity
labels.name: SetParryImmunity
labels.meaning: Sets bit 5 (0x20) of P+0x704 to bit 0 of the param.

labels.label: Set Flag704Bit7
labels.name: SetFlag704Bit7
labels.meaning: Sets bit 7 (0x80) of P+0x704 to bit 0 of the param.

labels.label: Set Tracking Self
labels.name: SetTrackingSelf
labels.meaning: Writes the raw param to P+0x6D4 if it is below 0x39 (57).

labels.label: Set Opponent Tracking
labels.name: SetOpponentTracking
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists and the raw param < 0x39 (57), writes it to O+0x6D4 (tracking/alignment amount).

labels.label: Set Vulnerability
labels.name: SetVulnerability
labels.meaning: Writes the low 16 bits of the param to the three vulnerability/posture words P+0x434, P+0x438, P+0x43C, and its bits 11..15 (param>>11) to P+0x688.

labels.label: Set Characters Linked
labels.name: SetCharactersLinked
labels.meaning: Updates bit 0x40000 of contact_flags (P+0xFDC) on both the player and the opponent: param 0 sets it, param != 0 clears it.
labels.evidence: if (uVar2 == 0) uVar18 = 0x40000; *(uint*)(P+0xfdc) = *(P+0xfdc) & 0xfffbffff | uVar18; same on lVar24

labels.label: Set Hurtbox Scale A
labels.name: SetHurtboxScaleA
labels.meaning: Stores the low 16 bits of the param at P+0x5F0. The values (2048, 1024, 4096, 8192) look like 4.12 fixed point (4096 = 1.0).

labels.label: Set Hurtbox Scale B
labels.name: SetHurtboxScaleB
labels.meaning: Stores the low 16 bits of the param at P+0x5F4. The values look like 0x81FE's (0, 4096, 8192, 12288: 4.12 fixed point?).

labels.label: Set Slot Vector Mask
labels.name: SetSlotVectorMask
labels.meaning: Overwrites the enabled-slot bitmask P+0x628 with the low 16 bits of the param. 0x8415 sets one bit of this mask when it writes the vec3 of slot n at P+0xA70+n*0x20.

labels.label: Set Pair62C630
labels.name: SetPair62C630
labels.meaning: Splits the param into two signed 16-bit halves: high half to P+0x630, low half to P+0x62C.

labels.label: Set Flag6FF
labels.name: SetFlag6FF
labels.meaning: Sets bool P+0x6FF = (low16 != 0).

labels.label: Set Footstep Fx
labels.name: SetFootstepFx
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x6D8 to 2 when the param is non-zero, else 0.

labels.label: Set Flag704 100
labels.name: SetFlag704_100
labels.meaning: Copies bit 0 of low16 into bit 8 (0x100) of P+0x704.

labels.label: Set Flag704Bit9
labels.name: SetFlag704Bit9
labels.meaning: Sets bit 9 (0x200) of P+0x704 to bit 0 of the param.

labels.label: Set Flags704 400 800
labels.name: SetFlags704_400_800
labels.meaning: Copies bit 0 of low16 into bit 0x400 of P+0x704, and sets bit 0x800 when rec[2] != 0 (cleared otherwise).

labels.label: Set Flag704 2000
labels.name: SetFlag704_2000
labels.meaning: Sets or clears bit 0x2000 of P+0x704 from bit 0 of the param (1 = set, 0 = clear).

labels.label: Set Stored Yaw Relative
labels.name: SetStoredYawRelative
labels.meaning: P+0x1590 = current yaw converted to game angle units (FUN_1418adc40 wraps a radian float to [0,2pi) and scales it to int) + signed low 16 bits of param. 32768 = half turn.
labels.evidence: sVar17 = FUN_1418adc40(); *(int *)(P + 0x1590) = (int)sVar17 + (int)(short)uVar2;  callee: wrap xmm0 by 2pi, mulss, cvttss2si

labels.label: Set Value568Level
labels.name: SetValue568Level
labels.meaning: Maps param 0/1/2/3 to 60/40/20/0 and writes it to P+0x568 (other values leave it unchanged).
labels.evidence: if (uVar2 == 0) *(P+0x568) = 0x3c; else if (==1) 0x28; else if (==2) 0x14; else if (==3) 0

labels.label: Set Byte6A2
labels.name: SetByte6A2
labels.meaning: Stores the param low byte at P+0x6A2.

labels.label: Set Flag710Bit0
labels.name: SetFlag710Bit0
labels.meaning: Copies bit 0 of the param into bit 0 of P+0x710.

labels.label: Set Flag710Bit2
labels.name: SetFlag710Bit2
labels.meaning: Sets bit 2 (0x4) of P+0x710 to bit 0 of the param.

labels.label: Set Flag710Bit1
labels.name: SetFlag710Bit1
labels.meaning: Copies param bit 0 into bit 1 (0x2) of P+0x710.

labels.label: Set6E0
labels.name: Set6E0
labels.meaning: Stores the raw param in P+0x6E0.

labels.label: Set Back Turn Flag
labels.name: SetBackTurnFlag
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x6E0 to 1 when the low 16 bits of the param are non-zero, else 0.

labels.label: End Back Turn
labels.name: EndBackTurn
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x6E0 to 2 when the param is non-zero, else 0.

labels.label: Store Value5EC
labels.name: StoreValue5EC
labels.meaning: Stores low16 in P+0x5EC.

labels.label: Set Opponent Field5EC
labels.name: SetOpponentField5EC
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, stores low16 at opponent +0x5EC.

labels.label: Set Flags6EE 6F1
labels.name: SetFlags6EE_6F1
labels.meaning: Sets the four bytes P+0x6EE, 0x6EF, 0x6F0 and 0x6F1 to 1. The param is ignored.

labels.label: Set All Glow Slots
labels.name: SetAllGlowSlots
labels.meaning: Sets all six glow slots P+0x6ED..0x6F2 to (param != 0).

labels.label: Set Flag710Bit3
labels.name: SetFlag710Bit3
labels.meaning: Sets bit 3 (0x8) of P+0x710 to bit 0 of the param.

labels.label: Set Flag710 10

labels.meaning: Sets or clears bit 0x10 of P+0x710 from bit 0 of the param (1 = set, 0 = clear).

labels.label: Set Flag710 20
labels.name: SetFlag710_20
labels.meaning: Sets or clears bit 0x20 of P+0x710 from bit 0 of the param (1 = set, 0 = clear).

labels.label: Set Flag710 40000000
labels.name: SetFlag710_40000000
labels.meaning: Copies bit 0 of the low 16 bits of the param into bit 30 (0x40000000) of P+0x710.

labels.label: Save540To1AD8
labels.name: Save540To1AD8
labels.meaning: Copies P+0x540 into P+0x1AD8 (save).

labels.label: Set540And Hit Flag
labels.name: Set540AndHitFlag
labels.meaning: Writes low16 to P+0x540; when it is 0, also sets bit 4 of hit_flags (P+0xFE0) and bit 0x200 of P+0x714.

labels.label: Restore540From1AD8
labels.name: Restore540From1AD8
labels.meaning: Copies P+0x1AD8 back into P+0x540 (restore).

labels.label: Set Flag486
labels.name: SetFlag486
labels.meaning: Sets byte P+0x486 = 1 (cleared by 0x8364).

labels.label: Set Flag1C84Bit11
labels.name: SetFlag1C84Bit11
labels.meaning: Sets bit 11 (0x800) of P+0x1c84 to (param != 0).

labels.label: Set1C84Bit2
labels.name: Set1C84Bit2
labels.meaning: Sets bit 2 of P+0x1C84 (param ignored).

labels.label: Roll Random Chance BD5
labels.name: RollRandomChanceBD5
labels.meaning: Sets P+0xBD4 = 1 and, if P+0xBD5 is not yet set, rolls a chance: base = the u32 at +0xC of a per-player struct (FUN_141910590), scaled by param% when param != 0, plus P+0x164C, capped at 90; if Random(100) < that chance, sets P+0xBD5 = 1.

labels.label: Set Flag1C38
labels.name: SetFlag1C38
labels.meaning: Sets bool P+0x1C38 = (param != 0). Self twin of 0x8229 (opponent).

labels.label: Set Opponent Flag1C38
labels.name: SetOpponentFlag1C38
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, sets bool O+0x1C38 = (param != 0). Opponent twin of 0x8228.

labels.label: Set Opponent Input Mode
labels.name: SetOpponentInputMode
labels.meaning: Writes the raw param to the opponent's P+0x2940 (input_mode in the retail layout map).

labels.label: Set Power Crush
labels.name: SetPowerCrush
labels.meaning: Unless P+0x1D31 is set: P+0xC41 = (byte3 != 0) power crush active, P+0xC44 = byte2 (100 dominant, likely damage-taken percent), byte1 != 0 sets P+0xC48/0xC49/0xC4A = 1, P+0xC4B = (byte0 == 0), P+0xC42 = 0. 0x837D also stores rec[2] at P+0xC50. If the power crush is off and P+0xC20 == 1, P+0xBE8 = 2.

labels.label: Set Power Crush
labels.name: SetPowerCrush
labels.meaning: Unless P+0x1D31 is set: P+0xC41 = (byte3 != 0) power crush active, P+0xC44 = byte2 (100 dominant, likely damage-taken percent), byte1 != 0 sets P+0xC48/0xC49/0xC4A = 1, P+0xC4B = (byte0 == 0), P+0xC42 = 0. 0x837D also stores rec[2] at P+0xC50. If the power crush is off and P+0xC20 == 1, P+0xBE8 = 2.

labels.label: Rage Art Activate
labels.name: RageArtActivate
labels.meaning: Rage Art state machine, P+0xC20 = phase. Phase 1 (from 0, with P+0xC24 == 0): fires Round3 events 0x31 and 0x4A8 for this slot, an effect, records the first rage-art slot in Round4+0x4F0, and handles extraprop 0x822D. Phase 3 (with P+0xC24 == 1): calls a manager virtual and saves the opponent HP points into P+0x1AF0. Also increments rage-art stats counters.

labels.label: Set Install Aura Alt
labels.name: SetInstallAuraAlt
labels.meaning: Toggles the character install state from (low16 != 0). If Round4+0x24 < 1, calls sub_1415A4660(P, on), the same callee as 0x83B1 'Set Character Installs'. Otherwise calls FUN_141892dd0(P, on), which on enable sets P+0x1644 = 1.0 and spawns aura effects.

labels.label: Set Power Crush Variant
labels.name: SetPowerCrushVariant
labels.meaning: Power-crush setup: P+0xC41 and P+0xC42 = (param byte3 != 0), P+0xC44 = param byte2, and fixed P+0xC48=0, C49=1, C4A=0, C4B=1.

labels.label: Add Gauge1D0CClamped
labels.name: AddGauge1D0CClamped
labels.meaning: Adds the raw signed param to P+0x1D0C and clamps it to [0, P+0x1D10].
labels.evidence: v = P+0x1d0c + uVar21; if (v<0) v=0; if (P+0x1d10 < v) v = P+0x1d10

labels.label: Add Character Gauge
labels.name: AddCharacterGauge
labels.meaning: If round-struct +0x24 < 1 and P+0x1D1C, P+0x1D1D, P+0x1545 are all 0: adds the signed param to the gauge P+0x1D14, clamps to [0, P+0x1D18]; on reaching the max from below calls FUN_1418d7860 and FUN_141891f50(P,1); feeds the delta*0x1000 to FUN_14188bf90(P+0x2810); sets P+0x1545 = 1 (once per frame/move).

labels.label: Set State Code6D0
labels.name: SetStateCode6D0
labels.meaning: Writes the raw param to P+0x6D0 (state code; 0x8296/0x8297 set it to 3 for the air state).

labels.label: Set Facing Mode
labels.name: SetFacingMode
labels.meaning: Sets facing2 (P+0x376) from a reference angle (P+0x382, or P+0x386 when P+0x710 bit 0x4000000 is set): param 1 = reference, 2 = reference + 180 degrees, 3 = copy P+0x374, other (0) = reference written to both facing2 and facing (P+0x17E).
labels.evidence: if (uVar21==2) P+0x376 = ref - 0x8000; else if (==3) P+0x376 = P+0x374; else {P+0x376 = ref; P+0x17e = ref;}

labels.label: Set Input Mode
labels.name: SetInputMode
labels.meaning: Stores the raw param in P+0x2940 (input_mode).

labels.label: Set Gauge Lock1
labels.name: SetGaugeLock1
labels.meaning: Sets bool P+0x1D1C = (param != 0); this lock blocks 0x8232 AddCharacterGauge.

labels.label: Set Gauge Lock2
labels.name: SetGaugeLock2
labels.meaning: Sets bool P+0x1D1D = (param != 0); second lock checked by 0x8232 AddCharacterGauge.

labels.label: Skip To Frame
labels.name: SkipToFrame
labels.meaning: Sets the pending frame-skip target P+0x2908 = low16.

labels.label: Skip Frames Forward
labels.name: SkipFramesForward
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x2908 = move_timer (P+0x390) + low16.

labels.label: Skip Frames Backward
labels.name: SkipFramesBackward
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x2908 = move_timer (P+0x390) - low16.

labels.label: Skip To Frame Flag1000
labels.name: SkipToFrameFlag1000
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x2908 = low16 + 0x1000 (frame target tagged with mode bit 0x1000).

labels.label: Skip Frames Forward From Move Frame
labels.name: SkipFramesForwardFromMoveFrame
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x2908 = P+0x3A4 (move frame counter) + low16.

labels.label: Skip Frames Backward From Move Frame
labels.name: SkipFramesBackwardFromMoveFrame
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x2908 = P+0x3A4 - low16.

labels.label: Skip To Random Frame
labels.name: SkipToRandomFrame
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x2908 = Random(low16) (0..N-1), forced to 1 when the roll is 0.

labels.label: Skip Frames Forward Random
labels.name: SkipFramesForwardRandom
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x2908 = move_timer (P+0x390) + Random(low16).

labels.label: Skip Frames Forward Random From Move Frame
labels.name: SkipFramesForwardRandomFromMoveFrame
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x2908 = P+0x3A4 + Random(low16).

labels.label: Force Move On Opponent
labels.name: ForceMoveOnOpponent
labels.meaning: Needs an opponent. If rec[2]!=0 it defers: P+0x2390 = O id, P+0x2394 = move id (low16), P+0x2396=0, P+0x2397 = rec[3]!=0. Otherwise it resets O (vtable +0x38 on O+0x3A20), UI widget 3 and manager 3, zeroes O+0x1BD0..0x1BE0, and calls GetMove(P, O, moveid, 0), with rec[3] as the reset flag.

labels.label: Force Move On Opponent
labels.name: ForceMoveOnOpponent
labels.meaning: Requires an opponent. If rec[2] != 0, defers it: P+0x2390 = opponent +4 (player index), P+0x2394 = move id, P+0x2396 = 0, P+0x2397 = (rec[3] != 0). Otherwise calls GetMove(P, opponent, move id, 0) directly with (rec[3] != 0) as extra arg.

labels.label: Set Anim Speed
labels.name: SetAnimSpeed
labels.meaning: Sets the animation speed P+0x440 = clamp((short)param, P+0x44C, P+0x448), in 4.12 fixed point (0x1000 = 1.0). If P+0x444 is still clear, sets it to (speed != 1.0).

labels.label: Add Anim Speed
labels.name: AddAnimSpeed
labels.meaning: Adds (float)signed-low16 times a factor from sub_141612530(P,0) (retail 0x1419102B0) to the animation speed P+0x440, clamps it to [P+0x44C, P+0x448], and if P+0x444 is clear sets it to (speed != 0x1000).

labels.label: Set Opponent Speed
labels.name: SetOpponentSpeed
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, sets O+0x440 (speed, 0x1000 = 1.0) to the signed low16 param clamped to [O+0x44c, O+0x448], and if O+0x444 is clear, sets it to (speed != 0x1000).

labels.label: Add Opponent Anim Speed
labels.name: AddOpponentAnimSpeed
labels.meaning: Same as 0x8247 on the opponent: O+0x440 += f(O,0) * signed low16, clamped to [O+0x44C, O+0x448], and O+0x444 set when the speed differs from 0x1000.

labels.label: Set Max Anim Speed
labels.name: SetMaxAnimSpeed
labels.meaning: Writes the sign-extended low16 to P+0x448 (max animation speed).

labels.label: Set Min Player Speed
labels.name: SetMinPlayerSpeed
labels.meaning: Stores the sign-extended low16 at P+0x44C.

labels.label: Change Animation Keep Move
labels.name: ChangeAnimationKeepMove
labels.meaning: Looks up move low16 (GetMoveFromID), saves its qword at +0x50 and a value read by 0x1418AF180, then overwrites the whole 0x448-byte target move entry with a copy of the current move (P+0x3E0), restores the saved +0x50 qword and the saved value (through 0x1418B60D0), and makes that entry the current move (P+0x3E0 and P+0x3D8). Net effect: the current move continues with the target move's preserved (animation) fields.
labels.evidence: uVar23 = target[10]; v = f_af180(target); copy 137 qwords from *(P+0x3e0) to target; target[10] = uVar23; f_b60d0(target, v); *(P+0x3e0) = *(P+0x3d8) = target

labels.label: Set Byte6C0
labels.name: SetByte6C0

labels.name: SetPendingMove

labels.label: Set Byte6C1
labels.name: SetByte6C1

labels.label: Set Field5E0
labels.name: SetField5E0

labels.label: Set Horizontal Anim Distance Multiplier
labels.name: SetHorizontalAnimDistanceMultiplier

labels.label: Set Opponent Field EC4
labels.name: SetOpponentFieldEC4

labels.label: Set Flag1ACD
labels.name: SetFlag1ACD

labels.label: Apply Pushback Self
labels.name: ApplyPushbackSelf
labels.meaning: Picks pushback entry #param (16 bytes) from the moveset's pushback table (moveset P+0x3B58, +0x1B0) and loads it: P+0x28D0 = entry ptr, P+0x1584 = entry.s16[0] (duration), P+0x1C08 = (float)entry.s16[1] (displacement), P+0x1588 = entry.u32@+4, P+0x1C00 = entry.u64@+8 (extra data ptr).

labels.label: Set Value158CFrom Base
labels.name: SetValue158CFromBase
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x158C = low16 + P+0x1058.

labels.label: Align Pushback With Self
labels.name: AlignPushbackWithSelf
labels.meaning: Sets the pushback direction P+0x158C = facing (s16 P+0x374) + 0x8000 (180 degrees) + low16.

labels.label: Set Pushback Angle
labels.name: SetPushbackAngle
labels.meaning: Sets the pushback direction P+0x158C to the current facing2 (P+0x376) plus param low16 (angle offset).

labels.label: Set Gravity
labels.name: SetGravity
labels.meaning: Clears P+0x474 and sets P+0x6E4 = (param == 0): param 0 disables gravity (sets the flag), param 1 enables it.

labels.label: Apply Pushback Opponent
labels.name: ApplyPushbackOpponent
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, picks pushback entry #low16 (16 bytes) from P's moveset pushback table (*(P+0x3B58)+0x1B0) and loads it into the opponent: O+0x28D0 = entry, O+0x1C00 = entry qword at +8, O+0x1584 = s16[0], O+0x1C08 = (float)s16[1], O+0x1588 = u32 at +4.

labels.label: Set Opponent Pushback Angle From Base
labels.name: SetOpponentPushbackAngleFromBase
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, O+0x158C (pushback angle) = low16 + P+0x1058.

labels.label: Align Opponent Pushback With Self
labels.name: AlignOpponentPushbackWithSelf
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, O+0x158C (pushback angle) = P+0x374 (P's facing) + 0x8000 (180 deg) + low16.

labels.label: Copy Pushback To Opponent
labels.name: CopyPushbackToOpponent
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists and P has a current pushback entry (P+0x28D0), loads that same entry into the opponent (O+0x28D0, +0x1C00, +0x1584, +0x1C08, +0x1588).
labels.evidence: psVar38 = *(short **)(P + 0x28d0); if (!psVar38) return; goto LAB_14189f840 (same loader as 0x825D)

labels.label: Copy Pushback State To Opponent
labels.name: CopyPushbackStateToOpponent
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, copies P's live pushback state (+0x1C00 extra ptr, +0x1584 frames, +0x1C08 distance, +0x1588 extra count) into the opponent, without the entry pointer.

labels.label: Set Attached Prop Type
labels.name: SetAttachedPropType
labels.meaning: Stores the low16 param in P+0x3ec4, the type used by 0x8263 to compute the prop position and choose its effect.

labels.label: Start Attached Prop Anim
labels.name: StartAttachedPropAnim
labels.meaning: Loads entry param (16 bytes) of the motbin table at motbin+0x1b0 into P+0x3f00..0x3f10, marks it active (P+0x3f20 = 1), computes a position (sub_1415C4AA0 with type P+0x3ec4) into P+0x3ed0 and copies it into P+0x29d0.. for P+0x6c4 entries, then fires an effect/event (FUN_1418b41a0 ids 0x60..0x65) chosen by the type P+0x3ec4.

labels.label: Stop Attached Prop Anim
labels.name: StopAttachedPropAnim
labels.meaning: Calls FUN_1418b8740(P,1), which resets the attached-prop state that 0x8263 starts (P+0x3f08/0x3f14=0x80/0x3f1c/0x3f20) and, with arg 1, sends stop events 100, 99, 97... for P's slot (same event ids 0x8263 fires).
labels.evidence: FUN_1418b8740(P,1); callee: mov [rcx+0x3f14],0x80; mov [rcx+0x3f1c],0; mov [rcx+0x3f08],0; mov [rcx+0x3f20],0; then FUN_1418c9af0(...,0x64/0x63/0x61,...)

labels.label: Apply Secondary Pushback
labels.name: ApplySecondaryPushback
labels.meaning: Loads pushback entry #low16 from P's moveset table into a second slot: P+0x3F70 = entry+8, P+0x3F78 = s16[0], P+0x3F7C = s16[1], P+0x3F7A = s16[2], P+0x3F7E = 0x80, then calls sub_1415C4550 (retail 0x1418CB090)(P, P+0x3F30, P+0x3F40).

labels.label: Set Secondary Pushback Param
labels.name: SetSecondaryPushbackParam
labels.meaning: Writes low16 to P+0x3F7E (the value 0x8265 defaults to 0x80).

labels.label: Set474Float
labels.name: Set474Float
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x474 to the signed low16 as float (e.g. -50.0).

labels.label: Stop Vertical Motion No Gravity
labels.name: StopVerticalMotionNoGravity
labels.meaning: Zeroes the vertical velocity/accumulator P+0x474 and sets the no-gravity flag P+0x6E4 = 1. This is 0x825C (SetGravity) with param 0.

labels.label: Set Slide Speed
labels.name: SetSlideSpeed
labels.meaning: Sets P+0x460 (float) to the param converted from signed int; params like -7000 suggest a slide velocity in internal units.

labels.label: Slide Player
labels.name: SlidePlayer
labels.meaning: Clears bit 0x8000 of P+0x704 and stores low16 in P+0x558 (slide parameter, 32768 in data).

labels.label: Slide Player World Axis
labels.name: SlidePlayerWorldAxis
labels.meaning: Sets bit 0x8000 of P+0x704 and stores low16 in P+0x558 (slide parameter).

labels.label: Rotate Player
labels.name: RotatePlayer
labels.meaning: Rotates P by low16 (s16 angle units, 0x10000 = 360 deg): adds it to facing2 (P+0x376) and facing (P+0x17E), and adds its radian conversion (FUN_141813530) to the yaw P+0x190, renormalised by 0x1418B3640.

labels.label: Rotate Opponent
labels.name: RotateOpponent
labels.meaning: Same rotation as 0x8272 applied to the opponent (O+0x376, O+0x17E, O+0x190).

labels.label: Push Player Along Axis
labels.name: PushPlayerAlongAxis
labels.meaning: Builds a rotation from two values (FUN_1418EB330 / FUN_1418EB050, likely sin/cos of the facing), rotates the vector (float(signed low16), 0, 0) with it (FUN_1417DF580) and adds the result's x to P+0x170 and its z to P+0x178.
labels.evidence: afStack_3b8[0] = (float)(short)param; pfVar48 = FUN_1417df580(v, ..., rot); P+0x170 += pfVar48[0]; P+0x178 += pfVar48[2]

labels.label: Push Player Local X
labels.name: PushPlayerLocalX
labels.meaning: Moves the player by the param distance along its local X axis: builds a rotation from the yaw (sin/cos via FUN_1418eb330/FUN_1418eb050), transforms the vector (param,0,0) and adds the result to world pos X (P+0x170) and Z (P+0x178).

labels.label: Set Flag710 10000000
labels.name: SetFlag710_10000000
labels.meaning: Sets or clears bit 0x10000000 of P+0x710 from bit 0 of the param (1 = set, 0 = clear).

labels.label: Set Player Height
labels.name: SetPlayerHeight
labels.meaning: Sets both pos_y (P+0x174) and root_y (P+0x234) to the signed low16 as float: an absolute height set, not an additive push.

labels.label: Shift Vertical Position
labels.name: ShiftVerticalPosition
labels.meaning: Calls FUN_141919390(P, float param). The callee adds a step (based on sub_1416124A0) to pos_y P+0x174 and to P+0x234, clamps pos_y at >= 0, and stores the remainder in P+0x255C/0x2564 with P+0x2560=0 for later frames.
labels.evidence: FUN_141919390(P); callee: addss xmm1,[rbx+0x174]; ... movss [rbx+0x255c], xmm0

labels.label: Spawn Projectile
labels.name: SpawnProjectile
labels.meaning: If the param < the projectile count (moveset P+0x3B58 +0x1A8): takes projectile entry param (0xE0 bytes, from +0x1A0), creates it with the spawn bone and offsets set by 0x827C..0x827F (local_18d8[0x10..0x14]), stores its id in P+0x62B0, sets a flag when the entry type is 0x3F0, schedules it with FUN_141916090 and sets the encrypted P+0x1CF8 = 120.

labels.label: Set Projectile Spawn Offset1
labels.name: SetProjectileSpawnOffset1
labels.meaning: Sets projectile spawn component local_18d8[0x11] = float(signed low16), the first of three offset/velocity values passed to the projectile spawn (0x827B).

labels.label: Set Projectile Spawn Offset2
labels.name: SetProjectileSpawnOffset2
labels.meaning: Sets projectile spawn component local_18d8[0x12] = float(signed low16), the second of the three values.

labels.label: Set Projectile Spawn Offset3
labels.name: SetProjectileSpawnOffset3
labels.meaning: Sets projectile spawn component local_18d8[0x13] = float(signed low16), the third of the three values.

labels.label: Set Flag71F
labels.name: SetFlag71F
labels.meaning: Sets bool P+0x71F = (param != 0).

labels.label: Push List Value720
labels.name: PushListValue720
labels.meaning: Appends the raw param to a small fixed list at P+0x720 (8 u32 entries, count at P+0x740); ignored when the list is full. Paired with 0x8282 which removes it.
labels.evidence: func_0x1418b3620(P+0x720, uVar21); callee: cmp [rcx+0x20],8; jae ret; mov [rcx+rax*4],edx; inc [rcx+0x20]

labels.label: Remove List Value720
labels.name: RemoveListValue720
labels.meaning: Removes every occurrence of the param from the list at P+0x720 (count at +0x20), shifting entries down. Pairs with 0x8281.
labels.evidence: func_0x1418ad890(P+0x720, uVar21); callee: loop cmp [r8+r10*4],edx; shift; dec [r8+0x20]

labels.label: Set Bone Sphere
labels.name: SetBoneSphere
labels.meaning: If the param != 0: enables P+0x748, converts the top byte (bone index) into a bone hash stored in P+0x74C, clears the state vectors, and sets radius = byte2*10 into P+0x760 and P+0x768 and radius squared into P+0x764. If the param == 0: disables it and resets the hash to the default 0x3F95F486.

labels.label: Set Bone Sphere Alt
labels.name: SetBoneSphereAlt
labels.meaning: Bone-sphere setup, alternate mode: clears P+0x748; if param != 0, sets P+0x749 = 1, resolves bone byte3 to a hash (FUN_14195B770), clears the state vectors and sets P+0x768 = byte2*10, P+0x764 = byte2^2*100, P+0x760 = byte1*10. If param == 0, clears P+0x749, resets the bone hash P+0x74C to 0x3F95F486 and clears the state.

labels.label: Array4F30Call65C0
labels.name: Array4F30Call65C0
labels.meaning: high16 selects entry i (< 0x18) of an array of 0xD0-byte records at P+0x4F30; calls func_1419165c0(&entry, low16 signed, {rec[2],rec[3],rec[4]}).

labels.label: Array4F30Call65A0
labels.name: Array4F30Call65A0
labels.meaning: Same as 0x8286 but calls func_1419165a0 on entry high16 of the P+0x4F30 array with low16 and {rec[2],rec[3],rec[4]}.

labels.label: Setup Scaled Damage
labels.name: SetupScaledDamage
labels.meaning: If P+0x1038 == 0, sets up a scaled-damage pool used by 0x828C. The attacker/defender pair is chosen by id: 0x8293 = (attacker P, defender opponent); 0x8294 = (opponent, P); 0x828B depends on P+0x4F4 > 0. The base value param is scaled by round damage modifiers (FUN_1418af790, InflictSelfDamage_maybe, FUN_141910590 +8, FUN_141970a40, the multiplier arrays at +0x1B00/+0x1B20, the +0x548 flag reduction FUN_1418af8a0), and the result goes to P+0xBD8 with the modifier count. The tail resets P+0xBDC, P+0xBE0, P+0x1574.

labels.label: Setup Scaled Damage
labels.name: SetupScaledDamage
labels.meaning: If P+0x1038 == 0, sets up a scaled-damage pool used by 0x828C. The attacker/defender pair is chosen by id: 0x8293 = (attacker P, defender opponent); 0x8294 = (opponent, P); 0x828B depends on P+0x4F4 > 0. The base value param is scaled by round damage modifiers (FUN_1418af790, InflictSelfDamage_maybe, FUN_141910590 +8, FUN_141970a40, the multiplier arrays at +0x1B00/+0x1B20, the +0x548 flag reduction FUN_1418af8a0), and the result goes to P+0xBD8 with the modifier count. The tail resets P+0xBDC, P+0xBE0, P+0x1574.

labels.label: Setup Scaled Damage
labels.name: SetupScaledDamage
labels.meaning: If P+0x1038 == 0, sets up a scaled-damage pool used by 0x828C. The attacker/defender pair is chosen by id: 0x8293 = (attacker P, defender opponent); 0x8294 = (opponent, P); 0x828B depends on P+0x4F4 > 0. The base value param is scaled by round damage modifiers (FUN_1418af790, InflictSelfDamage_maybe, FUN_141910590 +8, FUN_141970a40, the multiplier arrays at +0x1B00/+0x1B20, the +0x548 flag reduction FUN_1418af8a0), and the result goes to P+0xBD8 with the modifier count. The tail resets P+0xBDC, P+0xBE0, P+0x1574.

labels.label: Hit Scaled Damage
labels.name: HitScaledDamage
labels.meaning: Deals a share of the damage set up by 0x828B: func_0x1418ad5d0(P, pct) adds pct (0 = the rest up to 100) to P+0xBE0, computes P+0xBD8 * P+0xBE0 / 100, and returns the increment over P+0xBDC. That amount goes to the pending health op (P+0x103C = 1 damage, P+0x1040 = amount or -1 if 0, P+0x1044 = rec[2], P+0x1048 = 0, P+0x1049 = 1).
labels.evidence: iVar19 = func_0x0001418ad5d0(P,uVar51); *(int*)(P+0x1040) = iVar19; callee: [P+0xbe0] += pct; dmg = [P+0xbd8]*[P+0xbe0]/100; ret dmg - [P+0xbdc]

labels.label: Hit With Scaled Damage Self
labels.name: HitWithScaledDamageSelf
labels.meaning: Queues a health request of type 2 (P+0x103C=2) with amount = func_0x1418ad5d0(P, low16) (scaled). It stores rec[2] at P+0x1044 and sets P+0x1048=0 and P+0x1049=1.

labels.label: Scaled Heal Self
labels.name: ScaledHealSelf
labels.meaning: Queues HP-change command mode 3. The amount comes from 0x1418AD5D0: it adds the param to the percent at P+0xBE0 (param 0 resets it to 100), recomputes P+0xBDC = P+0xBE0 * P+0xBD8 / 100 and returns the delta (also stored at P+0x1574). Flag 0x1049 is set to 1.
labels.evidence: P+0x103c = 3; P+0x1040 = func_0x1418ad5d0(P,uVar51); callee: [P+0xbe0]+=edx; [P+0xbdc]=([P+0xbe0]*[P+0xbd8])/100; ret delta

labels.label: Queue Scaled Hp Cmd Mode4
labels.name: QueueScaledHpCmdMode4

labels.label: Trigger Stage Vfx

Then, if P is UE-bound and controller type is 1, calls FUN_141813100(P+0x160).

labels.label: Ballistic Launch
labels.name: BallisticLaunch

labels.label: Ballistic Launch
labels.name: BallisticLaunch
labels.meaning: Sets up a ballistic jump: from the move's root data computes a height (0x8391: relative to the floor via sub_141611C40), then if positive sets horizontal velocity P+0x470/P+0x478 = dir(facing2 + 180 deg) * (hi16 / lo16), P+0x474 = 0, gravity P+0x480 = 2*height / lo16^2, and flags P+0xD20, P+0x485, P+0x484 = 1, P+0x6E4 = 0.

labels.label: UEOpponent VCall1D8
labels.name: UEOpponentVCall1D8
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, calls vtable +0x1D8 of the UE-side object FUN_140a639e0(Round3) with (&opponent index O+4, high16 != 0).

labels.label: Start Fade38C0
labels.name: StartFade38C0
labels.meaning: Starts a timed 0..1 blend in the 3-field fader at P+0x38c0 {active, rate, value}. If the param's high 16 bits are non-zero, it sets active=1 and ramps value up to 1.0 over (low16) frames. Otherwise it sets active=0 and ramps value down to 0. A duration of 0 snaps the value immediately.

labels.label: Activate Heat Aura
labels.name: ActivateHeatAura
labels.meaning: sub_141644FE0 (retail 0x1419657E0) returns when Round4+0x24 > 0. Otherwise it calls FUN_1418da2d0 with P+4 and P+0x1012, then starts the persistent effect 0xA7 (FUN_1418c9190, as in 0x8022) and spawns attached effects 0xA8 and 0xB3 at tags 0x20252D6 / 0x67510C7F. When P+0x1C30 is set it uses 0xB4. It also stops 0xA7 and 0x89 in another branch (FUN_1418de740 + FUN_1418c9c90).
labels.evidence: 0x1419657E0: if (Round4+0x24 > 0) return; FUN_1418da2d0(Round3,&P->id,P+0x1012); FUN_1418c9190(Round3,0xa7,&slot); FUN_1418db460(Round3,0xa8,...); FUN_1418db460(Round3,0xb3,...); ... 0xb4 / stop 0xa7, 0x89

labels.label: Opponent KOEffect Burst
labels.name: OpponentKOEffectBurst
labels.meaning: Calls sub_141644FE0 (retail 0x1419657E0) on the opponent. Unless Round4+0x24 > 0, it sends a Round3 event for the target (0x1418DA2D0 with O+4 and O+0x1012), effect id 0xA7 (0x1418C9190 and 0x141898160 on O), then looks up bone 0x020252D6 on O's skeleton and spawns effect 0xA8 at that bone.

labels.label: Set Value D38
labels.name: SetValueD38

labels.label: Place On Ground And Position Opponent
labels.name: PlaceOnGroundAndPositionOpponent
labels.meaning: If rec[2] == 0: runs a UE world query (vtbl +0x188) from P's collision params (P+0x2448/0x2460) and raised position (P+0x170..0x178 plus floor height sub_141611C40). On a hit it sets P's facing P+0x17E/0x376 from the result yaw and its x/z position, flags P+0x3800. If there is an opponent, it turns the opponent 180 degrees and places it `param` units ahead (O+0x170/0x184/0x230, O+0x178/0x18C/0x238), then calls FUN_14188b170. If rec[2] != 0, it does the same starting from the opponent.

labels.label: Set Vector38D4

labels.label: Set Cinematic Camera Flip
labels.name: SetCinematicCameraFlip

If rec[2] == 0, it reads the remaining time of the current cinematic camera P+0xC88 (iface +0x568), subtracts P+0x3BC for camera ids 8..17, and restarts the camera manager with (time-1, flag). Otherwise it toggles UI widget 0xE with the flag (inverted when the widget's side matches).

labels.label: Push Event9
labels.name: PushEvent9
labels.meaning: Appends 9 to the queue P+0xC9C (count u16 P+0xCDC, max 16), then calls Round3 sub-object vtable+0x28(0xE).

labels.label: Set State Flag C34
labels.name: SetStateFlagC34
labels.meaning: Sets P+0xC34 = (param != 0). On a rising edge it clears P+0x1C35, increments two saturating u16 stats counters (the per-slot table at +0xFC with stride 0x2A0, and +0x4A of the slot's stats record), then calls FUN_1418da490. On a falling edge it raises P+0x2550 to at least 2.

labels.label: Set Hp Request Flag1048

It then queues an event: P+0x103c = 12 (event type), P+0x1040 = gained amount, P+0x1048 = 1 (pending).
