labels.evidence: 0x1418F3A30: cmp r8d,3; jge ret; cmd = [0x1475c00d8 + (idx*2 + (on^1))*4]; P+0x1da0[idx] = on ? (flag?2:1) : 0; FUN_14195cfb0(visual, cmd, 0, flags)

labels.label: Visual Slot1DACOn
labels.name: VisualSlot1DACOn
labels.meaning: FUN_1418ec2a0(P, on = 1, idx = lo16, {rec[2] != 0, 0}): for idx < 2 it sets P+0x1DAC[idx] = 1, or 2 when rec[2] != 0, and drives the matching table visual command. 'On' half of 0x84D3.

labels.label: Visual Slot1DACOff
labels.name: VisualSlot1DACOff
labels.meaning: FUN_1418ec2a0(P, on = 0, idx = lo16, {0, rec[2] != 0}): for idx < 2 it sets P+0x1DAC[idx] = 0 and drives the matching table visual command. 'Off' half of 0x84D2. Same pattern as 0x84D0/0x84D1 on P+0x1DA0.
labels.evidence: uStack_18b8 = 0; uStack_18b7 = rec[2]!=0; FUN_1418ec2a0(P,0,lo16,&uStack_18b8); callee: mov [r14+rdx*4+0x1dac],eax

labels.label: Visual Mask Bit1DB4Clear
labels.name: VisualMaskBit1DB4Clear
labels.meaning: FUN_1418f37a0(P, 1, idx = lo16): for idx < 4 it clears bit idx of P+0x1DB4 (the 0 variant would set it), then sends the visual command from a local 8-entry table [idx*2 + 1] to the visual controller (FUN_14195cfb0). For idx 1 or 2 it also calls FUN_1418f67a0(P, 1), which stops several attached effects (FUN_1418c9c90, message 9).
labels.evidence: 0x1418F37A0: cmp ebx,4; jge; eax=[rcx+0x1db4]; dl? btr : bts; cmd=table[idx*2+dl]; FUN_14195cfb0(visual,cmd,0,0); if ((u16)(lo16-1)<2) FUN_1418f67a0(P,1)

labels.label: Set Mask1DB4Bit
labels.name: SetMask1DB4Bit
labels.meaning: Calls FUN_1418f37a0(P, 0, idx): when idx < 4, sets bit idx of P+0x1DB4 and notifies the battle registry. When the param is 1 or 2, also calls FUN_1418f67a0(P, 0).

labels.label: Set Actor Visual Param A
labels.name: SetActorVisualParamA
labels.meaning: FUN_1418f3900(P, kind 5, f) with f = (float)(s16)low16, clamped to 0 when <= 0. Unless FUN_1418afe90(round) is true, it writes f to +0x47C of the player's UE-side object (0x14190fc40: Round2 side entry + 0xB9E0, UE-bound players only) and zeroes +0x480.
labels.evidence: call site 0x1418a575c: test di,di; jg; xorps xmm6; movaps xmm2,xmm6; mov edx,5; call 0x1418f3900. Callee: cmp edi,5 -> [0x14190fc40()+0x47c]=xmm6, [+0x480]=0

labels.label: Set Actor Visual Param C
labels.name: SetActorVisualParamC
labels.meaning: FUN_1418f3900(P, 0xC, f), f = (float)(s16)low16 clamped to >= 0: writes the actor's +0x490 and zeroes +0x494 (kinds 0xB/0xC share it).
labels.evidence: call site 0x1418a5779: mov edx,0xc; callee: lea eax,[rdi-0xb]; cmp eax,1; jbe -> [+0x490]

labels.label: Set Actor Visual Param B
labels.name: SetActorVisualParamB
labels.meaning: FUN_1418f3900(P, kind 8, f), f = (float)(s16)low16 clamped to >= 0: writes f to +0x4A4 of the UE-side actor object and zeroes +0x4A8 (kinds 7/8 share this target), unless FUN_1418afe90 is true.
labels.evidence: call site 0x1418a5796: mov edx,8; callee: lea eax,[rdi-7]; cmp eax,1; jbe -> [0x14190fc40()+0x4a4]=xmm6

labels.label: Set Actor Visual Params BC
labels.name: SetActorVisualParamsBC
labels.meaning: FUN_1418f3900(P, 0xB, f) then FUN_1418f3900(P, 7, f), f = (float)(s16)low16 clamped to >= 0. Kind 0xB writes the actor's +0x490 (zeroing +0x494); kind 7 writes +0x4A4 (zeroing +0x4A8).
labels.evidence: call site 0x1418a57b3: movaps xmm2,xmm6; edx=0xb; call; movaps xmm2,xmm6; edx=7; call

labels.label: Set Actor Visual Params All
labels.name: SetActorVisualParamsAll
labels.meaning: FUN_1418f3900 with kinds 0, 0xD and 9 and f = (float)(s16)low16 clamped to >= 0. Any kind other than 5/7/8/0xB/0xC takes the 'all' path, so each call writes f to +0x47C, +0x4A4 and +0x490 of the UE-side actor object (zeroing +0x480/+0x4A8/+0x494). The three calls are equivalent.

labels.label: Visual Command
labels.name: VisualCommand
labels.meaning: Sends visual command lo16 with argument rec[2] (read both as int and float by the callee) to the player's visual controller (FUN_14195cfb0) without any state bookkeeping. This is the raw form of the 0x83B2 / 0x84D0 / 0x84D4 wrappers.
labels.evidence: FUN_1418f3850: visual = registry(Round2, P->id); FUN_14195cfb0(visual, lo16, 0, &rec[2]); callee: cmp esi,0x49; jump table; movss xmm0,[r9] ...

labels.label: Set Flag710 8000000
labels.name: SetFlag710_8000000
labels.meaning: Sets or clears bit 0x8000000 of P+0x710 from bit 0 of the param (1 = set, 0 = clear).

labels.label: Set Global Per Slot Flag138
labels.name: SetGlobalPerSlotFlag138
labels.meaning: Writes (param != 0) to the int at +0x138 + slot*4 of a global object (FUN_1417ecd70()), for slot P+0x160 < 2.
labels.evidence: FUN_1417ef6e0(g, uVar21 != 0, P + 0x160)  // [g + slot*4 + 0x138] = v if slot < 2

labels.label: Set Value3F98
labels.name: SetValue3F98
labels.meaning: P+0x3F98 = raw param.

labels.label: Set Value3F9C
labels.name: SetValue3F9C
labels.meaning: P+0x3F9C = raw param.

labels.label: Set Target Point Ahead
labels.name: SetTargetPointAhead
labels.meaning: Computes a point param*scale (sub_141611BC0) units ahead of the player, rotated by facing P+0x17E, and stores it as a vec4 at P+0x3FA0: x = offset.x + root x (P+0x184), y = ground height (sub_141611C40), z = offset.z + root z (P+0x18C), w = 1.0.
labels.evidence: P+0x3fa0 = off.x + P+0x184; P+0x3fa4 = ground; P+0x3fa8 = off.z + P+0x18c; P+0x3fac = 1.0

labels.label: Set Target Point Value3FB0
labels.name: SetTargetPointValue3FB0
labels.meaning: P+0x3FB0 = (float)param (value next to the target point).

labels.label: Set Opponent Floor Level
labels.name: SetOpponentFloorLevel
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists, calls FUN_14190e790(O, xmm1=?, xmm2=(float)rec[2], P). The callee copies P's position fields (+0x170..0x190, +0x17C..0x180 shorts, +0x230/0x238) onto O, offset by a rotated vector built from P's facing (P+0x17E), updates O's ground height (+0x174/+0x188/+0x234 from (float)rec[2] plus 0x141925670(O)) and sets O+0x3800 = 1. In short it places the opponent relative to the player and sets its floor height.
labels.evidence: 0x14190e8e9 addss xmm0,[rbx+0x184]; mov [rsi+0x170]...; comiss xmm12(rec2),0 -> 0x141925670()+rec2 -> [rsi+0x174],[rsi+0x188]; mov byte [rsi+0x3800],1

labels.label: Force Move On Opponent
labels.name: ForceMoveOnOpponent
labels.meaning: If the opponent exists, calls sub_1415F37F0_MoveId(P, O, low16) to put the opponent in move id low16.

labels.label: Reset Position And Set Yaw
labels.name: ResetPositionAndSetYaw
labels.meaning: Teleports the player to the origin (pos x P+0x170 and z P+0x178 = 0) and sets the yaw to param degrees: P+0x370 and P+0x190 = param*pi/180, facing shorts P+0x376/P+0x17E from FUN_1418adc40.

labels.label: Place Opponent In Front
labels.name: PlaceOpponentInFront
labels.meaning: If an opponent exists: computes P yaw + pi, sets the opponent's facing (+0x376/+0x17E) from it, writes the same yaw into P+0x370 and P+0x190, and places the opponent at P's root (P+0x230, P+0x238) plus the forward vector times the param; marks opponent +0x3800 dirty.

labels.label: Misc Battle Flag Switch
labels.name: MiscBattleFlagSwitch
labels.meaning: Switch on the param. 0/1/2/5/8: byte flags P+0x1D28/0x1D29/0x1D2A/0x1D30/0x1D38 = 1. 9/10/11: Round3 sub-object vtable calls (0x1A0, 0x198(1), 0x198(0)). 12: clears P+0x1D39 if FUN_1418aff70(Round). 13: P+0xD70 = 1. 20/21: FUN_1418cd760 events 0x31+0x4A8 / 0x4A9 with the player slot. 23: FUN_141806590(struct, P). 24: struct+0x1D8 = 1. 26: P+0x1D7D = 1.

labels.name: SetFlag1D2BInMode4
labels.meaning: P+0x1D2B = (param != 0) when the round mode (Round+0x6C) is 4, else forced to 0.

labels.name: SetRecoverableHealthRegen

labels.label: Set Player Service Pair38
labels.name: SetPlayerServicePair38
labels.meaning: Gets P's PlayerService entry (TK__PlayerService_Get(slot P+0x160)) and writes +0x3C = high16, +0x38 = signed low16. Same layout as SetRecoverableHealthRegen (+0x34/+0x30).
labels.evidence: e = PlayerService_Get(P+0x160); e+0x3c = local_1904; e+0x38 = local_1908

labels.label: Set Pair7A0
labels.name: SetPair7A0

labels.name: ConfigureC40Block

labels.name: SubValue1604

labels.name: StoryModeBattleMgrVfn138

labels.name: StoryModeBattleMgrVfn140

labels.name: SetFlagD50

labels.label: Set Float D54
labels.name: SetFloatD54

labels.label: Set Value D58
labels.name: SetValueD58

labels.name: StoryCondSetFlagD5A

labels.name: SetVectorD60
labels.meaning: Writes a 4-float vector to P+0xD60: x = byte3*100, y = byte2*100, z = byte1*100, w = 0 (bytes of the param scaled by 100, likely meters to UE centimeters).

labels.name: StartSequenceWithArgs
labels.meaning: On the subsystem singleton *0x149BE0B98: sets the state byte +0xE4 = 1 and stores rec[1], rec[2], rec[3] at +0xE8, +0x108 and +0x118.

labels.label: Queue Sequence Value
labels.name: QueueSequenceValue
labels.meaning: On the subsystem singleton *0x149BE0B98: if the state byte +0xE4 is 2 or 3 it becomes 3, then the raw param is appended to the u32 vector +0xF8 (end) / +0x100 (capacity), with a grow path when full.

labels.label: Set Flag1D3ASelf Or Opponent

labels.label: Set Battle Script Value
labels.name: SetBattleScriptValue
labels.meaning: Stores the raw param in field +0x128 of the battle-system subsystem singleton *0x149BE0B98 (nothing happens while it is null). Battle-object slot 0x240 (0x145AA7A80) returns the same field, and requirements 769/770/771 (0x301 >=, 0x302 <=, 0x303 ==) compare against slot 0x240, so this property sets the counter/phase those requirements test.

labels.name: BattleMgrAddCounter

labels.meaning: Reads the Round3 battle-manager counter (vfunc +0x240), subtracts the raw param, clamps at 0 and writes it back (vfunc +0x238). Inverse of 0x856B BattleMgrAddCounter.
labels.evidence: uVar18 = iVar19 - uVar21; if ((int)(iVar19 - uVar21) < 0) uVar18 = 0; (**(code **)(*plVar26 + 0x238))(plVar26,uVar18);

labels.meaning: Writes low16 to +8 of the PlayerService entry for this player (TK__PlayerService_Get(slot2)).

labels.name: AddPlayerServiceValue
labels.meaning: Adds the low16 param to +8 of this player's PlayerService entry (TK__PlayerService_Get(slot P+0x160)). Add variant of 0x8574 SetPlayerServiceValue.

labels.meaning: Subtracts the low16 param from +8 of this player's PlayerService entry (no clamp).

labels.label: Apply From822DProp
labels.name: ApplyFrom822DProp
labels.meaning: When P+0xC4D == 0 and the current move (P+0x3E0) has extra property 0x822D, calls FUN_1418940f0(P, that_prop+0x15 == 0, param != 0).

labels.label: Set Player Control Flag In Mode14
labels.name: SetPlayerControlFlagInMode14
labels.meaning: Only when the round struct's mode (+0x6C) is 0xE: picks P, or its opponent when sub_1416125E0(P) != 1 (retail 0x141910370: per-side field +0x14 from the Round2 player table), and on the player for whom it is 1 calls FUN_141915fb0(player, low16 != 0). FUN_141915fb0 writes that bool to byte +9 of the player and of its partners at P+0x3B80/0x3B88/0x3B90. When Round4+0x28 == 0x15 and vuln & 0x100 it restores P+0x434 from P+0x43C and, if the byte is 0, clears vuln bits 0x18 (P+0x434 and encrypted P+0x520).

labels.name: PartnerReset

labels.meaning: Increments (saturating 0xFFFF) one u16 counter in the player's stats record (DAT_14959a1b8, entry P+0x160 * 0x2A0): param 0 -> +0x8A, 1 -> +0x76, 2 -> +0x78, 4 -> +0x84, 5 -> +0x86, 6 -> +0x8C, 7 -> +0xBA, 8 -> +0x6C, 9 -> the opponent's +0x7C; 3 calls FUN_141914250(P, opponent).

replacements.label: Player on left side and backturned
replacements.meaning: True when side == 0 (the side req 0x94 calls left) and the player is backturned (P+0x37c > 0x4000). Nothing in the code checks a grounded state.

replacements.label: Player on right side and backturned
replacements.meaning: True when side != 0 (the side req 0x95 calls right) and the player is backturned (P+0x37c > 0x4000). No ground check.

replacements.label: "Related Player" Current Move != param
replacements.meaning: True when the current move name hash of the player at P+0x3b80 (decrypted move+0xf0) differs from param. False when the pointer or its move is null.

replacements.label: Wave/enemy index <= X
replacements.meaning: True when the global Round4+0x40C is <= the param. Same field id 0x3F8 compares as 'wave enemy index + 1', so this is a wave/enemy index check, not an RNG.

replacements.label: Wave/enemy index == X (0-based)
replacements.meaning: True when the global Round4+0x40c equals the param. Ids 1016 (Round4+0x40c + 1 == param, sheet-confirmed) and 784 (<=) read the same field as the wave/enemy index, so this is a 0-based wave/enemy index test, not RNG.

replacements.label: Not in story battle X
replacements.meaning: True unless mode is 4 (story) and the story manager's vfunc +0xA8 returns the param; i.e. false only in that specific story battle/stage.

replacements.meaning: Subtracts low16 from the u16 at P+0x181C.

replacements.meaning: Writes low16 to the u16 at P+0x181E.

replacements.meaning: Adds low16 to the u16 at P+0x181E.

replacements.label: Set projectile spawn bone
replacements.meaning: Resets the projectile spawn offsets (local_18d8[0x11..0x13] = 0), converts the param (bone index) into the spawn-bone hash local_18d8[0x10], and clears the flag [0x14]. Used before 0x827D..0x827F and 0x827B.
